explanation: The numbers 1 to 9 total 45, so each of the three rows must hold a third of that. Chinese tradition calls this square the Lo Shu.

claims.text: In a 3 by 3 magic square containing the numbers 1 to 9, every row, column and main diagonal adds up to 15.
The magic total of a 3 by 3 magic square of the numbers 1 to 9 is not 12, 18 or 45.
The numbers 1 to 9 add up to 45, and 45 divided by 3 is 15.
The 3 by 3 magic square is known in Chinese tradition as the Lo Shu square.
